method: Read every shipped splash and portrait (base and both skins, 6 fighters, 36 cards) in art/out/fighters/<id>: each splash at full size (1600 x 900), at card size (480 x 270) next to its 3D reference (art/.cache/fighters/paint/<sid>_<kind>_3d.png) and as chips at 128 and 64 px; each portrait at 1:1 next to its 3D reference and at 128 and 64 px. Extra crops at 2-3.5x: every face, the hands of Nurrow (all 3 splashes, Noon Fair and Shadeprint portraits), Odrum (base splash and portrait, Noon Fair splash and portrait, Shadeprint splash), Ulkro (base splash lower body, Long Evening splash and portrait glove), Nurrow and Lisvel feet. Re-ran card_qa.py on the 6 fighters and node tools/gen_store.ts --check.
storeGate: pass: store.json current, 32 offers, 8 shelves, delta-E 32/32
cardQa: 36 cards, 8 gate misses: blank tripwire on lisvel portrait 0.69, lisvel_gorgewalk splash 0.83, odrum_shadeprint splash 0.69, rishal_chalkline splash 0.80, rishal_lamplit splash 0.68, vashil portrait 0.67, vashil_chalkline portrait 0.79; hollow on rishal_chalkline portrait 14.2. Not flagged but high: ulkro_long_evening portrait glow 0.229, nurrow portrait cracked 0.105, ulkro_long_evening splash cracked 0.134.
scoreNote: Gauge only (a recent LoL splash: painted, dynamic, face-forward figure with strong value design and a figure that owns the frame). Every splash here is still the clean 3D finish, or 3D plus a face-only repaint, standing small and stiff on the plate, often in the plate's own hue (Nurrow orange on orange, Odrum Shadeprint and Nurrow Shadeprint lilac on lilac). Round 2 fixed real round-1 problems (Odrum's hollow eyes on the portraits, Ulkro's arrow through the face and stitch-teeth bust, Nurrow's back view and blade over the mask), but new model-level hand defects now show in the restaged frames, and the face-only repaints put photo-real human eyes into stylised carved masks. No fighter reaches 7.5.

Stiff static stand, figure about a fifth of the frame. Also stale: lisvel.glb was rebuilt in b962d8ad2 (13:15) after this card was rendered.
Sensitivity, unchanged: wrapped head, opaque eye band, smooth featureless lower face; at 128 and 64 px a blindfolded mummy or mannequin head. card_qa blank tripwire 0.69 (gate miss).
Unchanged: same wrapped head and eye band, the bow held level at the hip with a slack string while the other hand lifts arrows by the shoulder; legs cut at the frame bottom.
On-model against the 3D (light paint), but the wrapped head, eye band and smooth lower face read as a mummy or mannequin at 64 to 128 px.
Unchanged: the figure is milky white and nearly merges into the pale plate; the head is a white blob with the visor band; the bowstring is lost at card size. card_qa blank tripwire 0.83 (gate miss).
Clean paint, on-model, but the same wrapped head and eye band: mummy or blindfold read at chip size.

The restage fixed the raised claw palm, but the hand on the far hip (about x 1290-1340, y 400-480) is now a crumpled claw with needle spikes shooting off the fingers; the 3D reference is identical (mean abs diff 0.0), so it is the model's skinning at attack1 t 0.40. It reads as melted, spiked fingers at full size and as a ragged blob at card size. The orange-pink figure still sits on an orange plate with weak separation. Face: closed lids and smile read; a thin vertical seam runs from brow to cheek on the mask (watch).

On-model, closed-lid smiling mask, arms out in the ult staging. Watch: the mask carries the highest cracked score in the set (0.105) from a diagonal line across the nose and deep cheek creases; at 512 it reads carved wood, not cracked, so it is not failed.

The face now reads (front side, lids and smile), but the hand on the hip (about x 1250-1310, y 420-470) is the same spiked, shredded claw as the base splash: fragmented fingers with spikes, clearly visible at full size. Figure-ground separation weak (pink on peach).
On-model, closed lids kept. The lower-right hand holding the sickle is acceptable at 3x (an earlier watch for a claw does not hold at this crop).

The blade no longer crosses the mask, but the hand on the hip (about x 1240-1300, y 400-470) is long spidery claw fingers; the whole figure is a milky monochrome lilac on a lilac plate, and the pale lilac grinning mask over it leans eerie at card size.
On-model. Watch: crack lines on the forearm guard (also in the render).

The hollow holes are gone, but the face-only repaint put photo-real human eyes (white sclera, hazel irises, catch-lights) into the stylised carved mask under a scowling brow, with the mask's crack nicks across the band and cheek kept: a staring-eyes-behind-a-cracked-pale-mask read that is still in the horror or hockey-mask class, and the realistic eyes do not match the stylised render around them (AI-insert look). The near arm ends in a fingerless stump (about x 1270-1320, y 640-700). The pot's round blue window again reads as a large eyeball beside the face.
Pupils and lids in the recesses read at 512, 128 and 64; on-model against the render. Watch: crack nicks on the band and cheek, and an angry brow. Ships next to a failing splash (see notes).

The hand on the yoke (about x 900-960, y 320-350) is broken into fragmented fingers and gaps at full size. The repaint gave a crumpled, paper-white mask with small realistic eyes, the far eye sitting at the mask's edge off the plane; at card size it reads as a blank white mask with two tiny eyes.

Eyes and lids are fixed, but the hand on the yoke at the lower left (about x 220-320, y 200-300) is a fragmented, holed mesh with claw-like finger shards; the same defect is in the 3D reference, so it is the model at idle_lobby. It is in plain view at 512. Crack lines on the band.

The violet trousers are fixed (ink grey now). But card_qa's blank tripwire misses (0.69); the mask is a washed pink slab with dense crack lines and solid yellow eye slits without pupils, which at card size reads cracked and blank; the hand at the far hip is pixel-fragmented; the pale grey robe sits on the lilac plate like a cut-out.

Ruling 2's amber inlays are present, but the mask is covered in dark crack lines over the brow, between the eyes and down both cheeks, visible at 512 and still at 128: the cracked-face class. The inlays are solid yellow with only a lid line, no pupil.

The arrow is off the face and two lidded eyes read. But the lower robe (about x 950-1250, y 700-900) is see-through: the terrace lines and a foreground shrub show through it (same in the 3D reference), so the figure dissolves into the plate below the belt. The off hand is a fingerless orange paddle stump (about x 1260-1300, y 660-720).
Two lidded eyes in the slit, no stitch-tick teeth; on-model. Watch: the orange glove at the lower right is still a paddle stump (model).

No eyes resolve at all: the face is a pale wrap under a dark brown band inside the hood at full size, at 3.5x and at card size, so it reads as a blank or mummy face (round 2 already marked the missing eyes as a watch; under the blocker list it is a fail).

At 3x the slit shows a brown band with a lip-like lighter stripe and no visible eyes, over a fully wrapped lower face: it reads as a mouth or a blank band, not lidded eyes, and at 64 px as a mummy face. The paint.json note says lidded eyes; they are not there at this size.

Eyes read. But the thrower in the left hand is a white shaft with knobbed ends that reads as a femur bone at card size (skull/bone class), the left glove is a claw of orange finger strips, and the raised glove by the face is a holed mesh. Dart shaft runs down beside the cheek.

The raised glove beside the hood (about x 290-400, y 130-230) is a holed mesh: the background shows through round gaps in the fingers (same in the 3D reference), so it reads as a perforated or melted hand right next to the face at 512. card_qa glow reads 0.229 (not a gate, highest in the set). Eyes and lids are fine.

problems.what: Not touched in round 2: Lisvel's wrapped head with an opaque eye band and smooth face (mummy or blindfolded mannequin) and Rishal's slit face plate (blank mannequin) are still on every card, and both fighters' GLBs were rebuilt after the cards, so the cards are also stale.
problems.fix: Model-level face fix (units lane): Lisvel a visible brow and lidded eyes beside or under the band; Rishal lids or glazed eyes on the plate. Then re-render with build.py portraits <id> --only splash,portrait,icon --skins and re-verify.

problems.what: The new attack1 t 0.40 frame shows the hip hand as a crumpled claw with needle spikes (model skinning; the 3D reference is identical).
problems.fix: Pick a frame where the far hand is closed or hidden, or fix the hand weights or the card-only pose for that hand, then re-render; check every hand at 3x before shipping.

problems.what: The face-only repaints (paint_card hand <card> head) insert photo-real human eyes with white sclera and catch-lights into stylised carved masks and wraps. On Odrum, together with the scowl and the crack nicks, this keeps a staring cracked-mask read, and the style break is an AI-insert artefact.
problems.fix: Prompt the head pass for the portraits' darker, stylised lidded eyes (no bright sclera, no catch-light), and match the eye value to the 3D finish; add a sclera-brightness check to the head gate.

problems.what: Fragmented or holed hand meshes (the yoke hand on Noon Fair, Ulkro's raised glove) show through in plain view; the 3D references have the same defect, so it comes from the model or the pose.
problems.fix: Units lane: fix the skin GLB hand meshes, or restage so the hand sits behind the yoke or out of frame; add a hand crop to the ship checklist.

problems.what: Dense crack lines over the whole lacquer mask and solid yellow inlays without pupils: cracked-face class; the splash also misses the card_qa blank tripwire.
problems.fix: Thin the crack texture on the Shadeprint mask (ruling 2 asks for warm lacquer, not a broken one) and give the inlays a pupil or a darker lid band; re-render.

problems.what: No eyes resolve in the slit; the face reads as a blank wrap or a mouth band.
problems.fix: The same face-point head repaint used on the base, with stylised lidded eyes, then re-gate.

problems.what: The lower robe is translucent: terrace lines and a shrub show through below the belt (also in the 3D render).
problems.fix: Find the alpha or haze leak in the compose (plates.py figure mask) or the robe material in the card render, and re-render.

problems.what: card_qa blank tripwire misses (0.67, 0.79) on a visor design.
problems.fix: Either lift the face-plate carving and pane lids so the tripwire passes, or get a lead ruling that the tripwire exempts Vashil's visor. Also re-render all six Vashil cards from the current GLB so the shipped cowl is what CW5 is judged on.

problems.what: Small, stiff figures in the plate's hue; no splash is a painted, figure-led composition.
problems.fix: Larger figure framing and a value break between figure and plate before another full paint pass.

keepLive: every other card of the six fighters (27): lisvel x6, rishal x6, nurrow splashes x3, odrum_splash, odrum_noon_fair x2, odrum_shadeprint x2, ulkro_splash, ulkro_highrim x2, ulkro_long_evening x2, vashil_portrait, vashil_chalkline_portrait
notes: 9 of 36 pass; no fighter reaches par (7.5). Of the shipNow cards, the Nurrow portraits and the Vashil splashes plus First Bell portrait were already ok in roll2 and their files have not changed since, and odrum_portrait and ulkro_portrait are new passes. Consistency caveat for the lead: odrum_portrait (pupils in the recesses) and ulkro_portrait would ship next to their pre-round-1 live splashes, which still carry Odrum's hollow eye holes and Ulkro's arrow-through-face, so the fighter would show two different faces; ship them with their splashes or hold them. The Vashil passes are judged on a pre-crown-change render and do not close CW5. Read-only review: no card, tool or GLB was changed.
